coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across six canonical iPaaS workflow automation products (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato, Tray.ai, Pipedream) with comprehensive coverage across official product pages, documentation, pricing, third-party review aggregators (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius), analyst reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant 2026, Nucleus Research 2025 Value Matrix), funding databases (Crunchbase), acquisition announcements, and credible comparison/teardown articles. Deduplication applied across review aggregator URLs and analyst sources. Tier assignment follows competitive-leaf rubric: T0 captures primary/official sources and review aggregates; T1 includes official docs, API references, release notes; T2 brings analyst reports and market research; T3 covers practitioner comparisons and high-quality reviews. Coverage spans HCI pain points (surface-area bloat, learning curve, UI usability noted in reviews), market positioning, and feature differentiation. Notable gaps: no paywalled Gartner PDF captured (reference-only tier requires URL to accessible content), limited academic HCI research on low-code automation UX (market not yet a major CHI/UIST venue). Sources verified via WebFetch for authenticity (Zapier, n8n, Make, Pipedream, Workato, Tray.ai official pages confirmed). Total of 51 sources across 6 products + 4 analyst/market sources.
